nehemiah.8.p1.b1.text: And by the seventh month the Israelites had settled in their towns.

nehemiah.8.p1.b2.text: At that time all the people gathered together in the square before the Water Gate, and they asked Ezra the scribe to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded for Israel.

nehemiah.8.p1.b3.text: So Ezra read it aloud from daybreak …

nehemiah.8.p1.b4.text: … until noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate, in front of the men and women and those who could understand. And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.

nehemiah.8.p2.b1.text: Ezra the scribe stood on a high wooden platform built for this occasion. …

nehemiah.8.p2.b2.text: Ezra opened the book in full view of all the people, since he was standing above them all, and as he opened it, all the people stood up.

nehemiah.8.p2.b4.text: Then they bowed down and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

nehemiah.8.p3.b1.text: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah … instructed the people in the Law as they stood in their places.

nehemiah.8.p3.b2.text: So they read from the Book of the Law of God, explaining it and giving insight

nehemiah.8.p3.b3.text: so that the people could understand what was being read.

nehemiah.8.p4.b1.text: … For all the people were weeping as they heard the words of the Law.

nehemiah.8.p4.b2.text: “This day is holy to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep.”

nehemiah.8.p4.b3.text: “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared …

nehemiah.8.p4.b4.text: Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”

nehemiah.8.p5.b1.text: “Be still, since today is holy. Do not grieve.”

nehemiah.8.p5.b2.text: Then all the people began to eat and drink, to send out portions

nehemiah.8.p5.b4.text: because they understood the words that had been made known to them.

nehemiah.8.p6.b1.text: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and Levites, gathered around Ezra the scribe to study the words of the Law.

nehemiah.8.p6.b2.text: And they found written in the Law, which the LORD had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month.

nehemiah.8.p6.b3.text: “Go out to the hill country and bring back branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees, to make booths, as it is written.”

nehemiah.8.p7.b1.text: And the people went out, brought back branches, and made booths on their own rooftops, in their courtyards, in the court of the house of God …

nehemiah.8.p7.b2.text: From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated like this.

nehemiah.8.p7.b4.text: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. The Israelites kept the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day they held an assembly, according to the ordinance.
